description: Secret Santa generator: draw names with private links, free, no sign-up. Runs the draw right here in chat for a group of 3 to 100 and returns ONLY the links: one private link per person (labeled with that person's name) plus the organizer's manage link, which shows who has opened theirs and resends lost links. It never returns the pairings — no field of the answer says who drew whom; each match lives only inside its own person's link, which also shows gift ideas inside the budget. Give it every player's name and, optionally, a group name, a budget band, and keep_apart pairs (two-name lists, like [["Ana", "Ben"]], for people who must not draw each other). It validates the group (3 to 100 people, no shared names — the draw cannot tell two same-named people apart) and checks that a valid draw exists under the keep-apart pairs before drawing; if the pairs leave no fair draw, it names the conflict plainly and draws nobody. How the draw is stored, stated upfront: the draw is picked by this tool, and to make the private links work the names and matches are stored on the site's server in a form the site can read — the same records a draw on pickmysecretsanta.com creates, so the manage page, opened status, nudges, and rematch all work the same. The returned links live in this chat's history, under the chat platform's rules: anyone who can read this conversation can open them. If the organizer would rather no links sit in a transcript, use plan_secret_santa_setup instead — the draw then happens on the website. Each call runs a fresh draw; calling it again draws again and makes a new set of links (links from an earlier draw still work and still show the earlier matches).

budget_band.description: The group's budget band. Defaults to the site's own default, 25_to_50 ($25-$50), when not given.

group_name.description: Optional group name, up to 40 characters (for example "The Office Crew").

keep_apart.description: Pairs who must not draw each other, as two-name lists using names from the names list, e.g. [["Ana", "Ben"]].

names.description: Every player's name, one per person (3 to 100). Names must be distinct - add a last initial where two people share a name.

name: draw_secret_santa_names
title: Draw Secret Santa names
